text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that really helps. I'll gladly 
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No, no, this is no big deal at all! Right, 
guys?

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pals
text_block_list.text: Ouss!!
choice_data_list:
(It's Pokke and the others... I wonder 
what they're doing?)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't my partner! What's up, out 
for a walk?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm just helping out Fuji-san a bit. Here, 
take this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written there were the issues arising in 
the Ritto Dormitory— such as withered 
potted plants in the lobby and soap 
running low.
choice_data_list:
Incredible, Pocket and the others made 
this?

That's amazing, Pocket and the others did 
this?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Fuji-san's always looking into it, 
but... Man, it's seriously incredible!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She does it all by herself, you know? Even 
though looking around all over the place 
is tough.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So we were thinking maybe we could help 
out too. Well, we're nothing compared to 
Fuji-san, though.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's not true at all. You're very 
reassuring!
choice_data_list: Way to go, Pokke and everyone!
Way to go, Pokke and everyone!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heheh, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *Ahem*, that aside.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I heard that some people gather in 
someone's room and hang out even after 
lights-out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful that you're such good 
friends, but... It would be nice if you 
could be a bit more mindful of those 
around you.

text_block_list.name: Pocket and the Others
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, sir……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They might be delinquents, but they 
respect Fuji Kiseki and sometimes do good 
deeds. A few hours after catching a 
glimpse of this peculiar balance among the 
students—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...I went and talked things out with 
Rampage Racing. That should settle things 
for now."

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pal
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, Boss...! It's all 'cause I messed 
up big time...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Quit apologizing over and over. More 
importantly, curfew! It's curfew!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm cutting it pretty close, but I can't 
let Fuji-san lose face—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up, everyone! We are sticking to 
the schedule with everything we've got!! 
Got it!?"

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pals
text_block_list.text: Ouss!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing rumors that "Jungle Pocket and the 
others went off to brawl with outsiders," 
I came to check on the dorm out of 
concern, but—
choice_data_list:
Even you haven't received word, and you're 
the dorm head?

So even you haven't heard anything, and 
you're the dorm head.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But if it's Pokke—
—Uoooohhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Pocket and the Others
text_block_list.text: Saaaaaafe!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Right?! Fuji-san!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah! Welcome back, everyone.
choice_data_list: You made curfew right on time, Pokke!
You made curfew right on time, Pokke!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, partner! Well of course. It's nothing 
to praise me over.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. No really, you were a huge help. 
You even saved my "face"!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because if a dorm resident breaks curfew, 
I'm the dorm leader who gets scolded for 
it. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The responsibility for one's crew falls on 
the 'head,' would that be about right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pokke seemed to understand that. 
...Probably right from the very start.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Kh, Fuji-san...! You believed in me right 
from the start... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you really are so cool! Always makin' 
folks wanna come back home to you, that's 
seriously what's so great about you!
choice_data_list: You gave it your all, huh!
You gave it your all, didn't you!

Maybe having those feelings is what helped 
you run so fast.

Maybe having those feelings is what helped 
you run so fast.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you really are so cool! Always makin' 
folks wanna come back home to you, that's 
seriously what's so great about you!
choice_data_list: You gave it your all, huh!
You gave it your all, didn't you!

Maybe having those feelings is what helped 
you run so fast.

Maybe having those feelings is what helped 
you run so fast.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm not carrying the title of 
Fuji-san's junior with half-assed resolve.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to my feelings for Fuji-san, 
I'm the strongest too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You bet! Glad we made it in time somehow.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Wait, does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I can get infinitely faster. 'Cause my 
respect for you, Fuji-san, is infinite!"
